products.title: Deep Research Agent
products.short: Reads dozens of sources and returns a cited brief.
products.description: Give it a question and it plans a search, reads widely, compares sources and returns a short brief with every claim linked to where it came from. Built for decisions, not trivia.

products.title: Inbox Pilot
products.short: Sorts, summarises and drafts replies to your email.
products.description: Each morning it groups your unread mail by what needs you, writes a two-line summary of each thread and prepares draft replies for you to approve. Nothing is sent without you.

products.title: Meeting Scribe
products.short: Turns meeting notes into decisions and next steps.
products.description: Paste a transcript or rough notes and get back the decisions made, open questions and a tidy list of next steps with owners, ready to share with the team.

products.title: Launch Planner
products.short: Builds a week-by-week plan for your product launch.
products.description: Describe what you are launching and when. It drafts a week-by-week plan, a checklist for launch day and the announcement copy, then adjusts as dates move.

products.title: Support Concierge
products.short: Answers customer questions from your own help docs.
products.description: Point it at your help pages and it answers customer questions in your tone, hands tricky ones to a person and keeps a list of questions your docs don't cover yet.

products.title: Study Companion
products.short: Explains, quizzes and plans revision with you.
products.description: Upload a chapter or a topic list. It explains each idea in plain language, quizzes you until it sticks and builds a revision plan around your exam date.

products.title: Market Scout
products.short: Watches your market and sends a weekly digest.
products.description: Tell it the companies and topics you care about. Every week it gathers what changed, explains why it matters and flags anything that needs a decision.

products.title: Itinerary Muse
products.short: Plans trips around how you like to travel.
products.description: Share your dates, budget and pace. It suggests a day-by-day plan with places to eat, quiet moments and backup ideas for rainy days, all in one shareable page.
